text:
Source-assisted reading of Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 225 (F-o7j1), made on the native images with Hostiensis's Lectura (Strasbourg 1512, vol. 1, fols. 168v-170r, MDZ bsb00018039 scans 338-341) at hand. Reread on the image by a research reader: face A (canvas 0) upper and lower bands across both strips, face B (canvas 1) upper half across both strips; corrections were made with the edition in hand. Read by an independent checker: the stained middle band of face A, first before opening the edition, then settled with it. The stained band of face B, the far column edges and the margin notes rest on the image-only first reading or are unread. Most entries below are the phrases relied on, not whole lines; "..." marks text not given. Regions x,y,width,height in native pixels. ( ) expansion; [ ] lost or supplied from the edition (not a reading); ? uncertain; | the cut between the strips.
